items.title: Write the Koala-to-Lattice role naming execution document
items.context: Capture inventory, canonical rename map, compatibility boundary, affected template/runtime/doc/test surfaces, and verification commands before changing the role IDs.

items.title: Rename canonical agent templates and mirrored host assets from koala-* to lattice-*
items.context: Template filenames, frontmatter names, prompt prose, .claude agent assets, and .Codex agent assets must share the same Lattice role IDs so regenerated assets do not reintroduce Koala names.

items.title: Update CLI runtime role dispatch, schemas, attribution, and help text to Lattice naming
items.context: story_dispatch defaults, reviewer requirement maps, command schemas, commit author fallback, review/pass/finding guidance, and visible help text must stop emitting koala-* identifiers. Legacy koala role aliases should be deleted unless needed only for read-only historical metadata.

items.title: Update documentation, audits, and tests so active surfaces no longer teach Koala naming
items.context: Active docs should teach lattice-* role IDs; legacy archived docs can remain only when explicitly marked historical. Tests and verifier snapshots should assert the Lattice naming surface.

items.title: Verify no active CLI/template/runtime surface still emits Koala role IDs
items.context: Run targeted rg inventory, CLI help/version checks, unit/build tests, and Codex adapter verification if host agent assets changed.
